paragraphs.text: Segovia is a plane where everything exists in miniature at about a 1:100 scale.

The largest creature on Segovia, a Segovian Leviathan , is about the size of a Dominarian elephant . When planeswalkers visit this plane they are automatically shrunk down to scale, but items taken out from Segovia are not equivalently enlarged. The people of Segovia watch sports such as chariot races in arenas called Hippodromes. It was once visited by Nicol Bolas , who noted its vastly aquatic nature. It features cities both on land and underwater.

During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Segovia was invaded by at least one Phyrexian centurion. Traveling to the plane via Realmbreaker 's omenpath did not cause the invading Phyrexian to shrink down to the appropriate size the way planeswalking would.
